integrity: Proof provides the matrix commutativity lemma, a complete semisimple slice, the diagonal-torus GIT invariant ring, and inverse seven-trace coordinate map. An exact symbolic checker accompanies it; no external independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Over complex numbers; reduced trace-zero boundary only; does not assert scheme-theoretic multiplicity or describe unclosed orbit classes; earlier unindexed explicit descriptions remain a novelty risk.
title: The trace-zero boundary of a three-crosscap \(\mathrm{SL}_2\)-character variety is an algebraic cylinder
